decisions.reason: The resin injection unit draws on the firm's core plural-component expertise and has its own web page, so dropping it after one year would write off the engineering investment and undo a visible commitment.
This second injection unit fills out the range alongside Product A, and with no clear evidence of failure, any weak early results can still be put down to market ramp-up.
Automatic airless guns are central to the firm's spray application business and its announced direction, so the commitment to this product is strong.
A manual airless gun is a core accessory that supports equipment and spare-parts sales, so little argues for dropping it.
The air-assisted airless gun completes the spray gun line the firm has presented publicly, and one year is too short for its results to rule out temporary causes.
The data logger is further from the firm's core and probably cost less to develop, but it fits the stated push toward innovative application technology, so management keeps it for now.
